mapper.select: SELECT id AS userId, username FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId}
SELECT id FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE
SELECT id, pdf_score AS score, pdf_update_count AS updateCount FROM jlpdf WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1 ORDER BY update_time DESC, id DESC LIMIT 1
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO jlpdf (id, user_id, user_name, pdf_score, pdf_update_count, status, create_time, update_time) SELECT #{id}, id, username, #{score}, 1, 1, NOW(), NOW() FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId}
mapper.update: UPDATE jlpdf SET pdf_score = #{score}, user_name = (SELECT username FROM `user` WHERE id = #{userId}), pdf_update_count = COALESCE(pdf_update_count, 0) + 1, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 1
